Overview.Name: Gopireddy Saranya
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 2: Egg bhurji (2 eggs) (pan-cooked) & small bowl cooked rice
Option 3: Curd rice (small bowl cooked rice & curd & salt)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (pressure-cooked) & curd (small cup)
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & fish curry (simple)
Option 3: Cooked rice (smaller portion) & paneer curry (pan-cooked)
Meal_3: Option 1: Egg curry (2 eggs) & small bowl cooked rice

Notes_and_Tips: Shift routine: set 3 fixed meal slots even if sleep is irregular.
Stress support: keep meals simple and repeatable; avoid skipping meals which worsens mood.
If cravings appear: start with buttermilk or fruit, wait 10 minutes, then decide.
Bedtime (optional): warm turmeric milk (small cup, no sugar) or warm water.
SIMS / nutrition theory note: protein-first meals and steady timing improve satiety and stable energy.
Keep cooking simple: pressure-cooked curries and pan-cooked eggs with minimal oil.
